title: SupportLtSharedAttempts
description: Server-only failure counts across all accounts at supportLtSettings/attempts. Keys of `counts` are ten-minute buckets (Math.floor(epochMillis / 600000) as a string); 200 failures within one bucket block registration for the rest of that bucket. registerSupportLt increments the current bucket atomically after each failed check and issueSupportLtCode deletes the document on rotation.
